method: Builder-controlled browser checks against the locally built Docker application and native HydraDB. These are observed workflow assertions, not an automated end-to-end test suite or independent customer trial.

checks.name: NORTH preview and creation
checks.observed: EUR/USD 1.20; company $308.00, NORTH $108.00. Preview reports 8 validation calculations; create reports 8 validation, 8 recorded and 11 verification calculations.

checks.name: Source correction withholds stale amounts
checks.observed: EUR/USD 1.30 publication identifies four affected artifacts. Previous $308/$108 amounts are historical, not current.

checks.name: Native path inspection
checks.observed: NORTH evidence path connects explicit exchange rates through convert_to_usd to the regional artifact.

checks.name: Selective refresh
checks.observed: Four recorded calls and 11 verification calculations; company $317.00 and NORTH $117.00; support preserved.

checks.name: Browser reload
checks.observed: Imported NORTH workspace, current values and explicit rate 1.30 restored. CSV text is not repopulated in the upload form.

checks.name: Canonical row reorder
checks.observed: Reordered CSV at rate 1.30 gives no changed sources and no recorded calls; eight validation calculations remain disclosed.

checks.name: Oversized input
checks.observed: 1,048,577-byte CSV rejected, including after a successful preview; previous readiness/create state cleared.

checks.name: Zero-support dynamic region
checks.observed: APAC/GBP fixture at 1.25 produces company $163.75 and APAC $93.75; money-only reports do not invent a support claim.

checks.name: Mobile layout
checks.observed: At 390x844, page and scroll widths both 390; workspace and update drawer controls usable.

checks.name: Application-container restart
checks.observed: After restarting only the app container and reloading, APAC values $163.75/$93.75 remain current.

checks.name: Guided/imported separation
checks.observed: Guided demo retains $5,565 company/$2,090 EU/support 2; returning to imported workspace retains APAC values.

checks.name: Wide desktop layout
checks.observed: At 1536x1024 all graph columns and reports are visible. Temporary viewport override reset after checks.

limitations: Local fixture data only; no public hosting or customer adoption trial.
The browser workflow uses seven typed analytics tools and bounded CSV input, not arbitrary report generation.
Screenshots document selected states and do not replace raw benchmark or automated backend evidence.
